title: Hong Kong Open: Eala on collision course with Sun, Williams drawn against Stoiana
text:
Hong Kong Open: Alex Eala on collision course with Sun Xinran, Williams to face Stoiana | South China Morning Post Hong Kong - Hong Kong Hong Kong Open: Eala on collision course with Sun, Williams drawn against Stoiana 1 Advertisement WTA (Women's Tennis Association) Sport Hong Kong Hong Kong Open: Alex Eala on collision course with Sun Xinran, Williams to face Stoiana 
 The main draw starts on Monday with the singles and doubles first rounds; meanwhile, Coleman Wong is into the ATP Challenger final in Seoul
 3 -MIN READ 3 -MIN 1 Listen Mike Chan Published: 7:04pm, 31 Oct 2026 Updated: 9:23pm, 31 Oct 2026 Two of the region’s rising stars could be on a collision course after Filipino sensation Alexandra Eala and Chinese teenage starlet Sun Xinran were picked on the same side of the Prudential Hong Kong Tennis Open draw on Saturday.
 Eala will take on Alycia Parks in the first round, while Sun, who is set to play in only her second WTA250 event in as many weeks, has Czech player Tereza Valentova in her way.
 The 46-year-old seven-time grand slam champion Venus Williams will play compatriot Mary Stoiana.
